integrity: Proof establishes the all-size statement analytically; the included Python 3 checker provides independent finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The parity converse is proven only for interval graphs; the octahedral graph shows failure for arbitrary graphs. No sharp pseudoinverse in singular cases, endpoint Banach projection, or independent audit is claimed. Historical priority is bounded by accessible scientific evidence.
title: Parity-complete Walsh invertibility for interval-graph independent sets
